notes: Verbless protasis: the construction-supplied copula *be* stays on the predicate nominal זֶבַח under rule 20, and the subject phrase קָרְבָּנוֹ keeps only its own words.
שְׁלָמִים headed on *peace* by rule 31's subtraction test; *offerings* as head remains defensible and is named in that unit's note.
The disjunctive pair אִם … אִם has one English word for each present morpheme, *whether* and *or*, so nothing is added or unrepresented there.
לִפְנֵי fuses to the single *before* under rules 19 and 30, headed on פָּנֶה.
